title: ADM-01 Administration
summary: Cost centre ADM-01 covers general administration in unit NBC-MAN-01 under Henrik Weber, with £180,000 available budget for 2026-Q4.
body:
Cost centre ADM-01 covers central plant administration for operating unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner [[user-hweber|Henrik Weber (HWEBER)]][^r1]. It serves as the default cost centre assigned to Henrik Weber in his role as Plant head[^r4]. As of 26 October 2026, the cost centre is open and holds £180,000 in available funds for the 2026-Q4 period[^r1][^r2].

## Budget and spending

For period 2026-Q4 as of 26 October 2026 09:00, cost centre ADM-01 has an allocated budget of £200,000, committed spend of £20,000, and an available budget balance of £180,000[^r2][^r3]. Detailed historical tracking across periods and active ledger balances are maintained in [[data-cost-centres-and-budgets|Cost Centres and Budgets FY2026-27]][^r2][^r3].

## Users

Cost centre ADM-01 is assigned as the primary default cost centre for Plant head [[user-hweber|Henrik Weber (HWEBER)]] in [[data-users-and-approval-limits|Users_and_approval_limits]][^r4].
